verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents OIDC/OAuth flows, device authorization grant, client credentials, and fine-grained authorization services, but contains no mention of CIBA (Client Initiated Backchannel Authentication) or any asynchronous out-of-band human-approval flow for agent-initiated transactions. Device authorization grant is a different flow (for input-constrained devices polling for a code) and is not evidence of CIBA-style push approval.
